title: 第5章 中州四大宗门第6章 四目相对
lines: 九品神果啊！
传说中的东西！
“原来这天底下真的有如此珍品啊！”
茶馆的众人激动万分！
就连无念都张大了嘴巴。
九品神果，这是无念想都不敢想的东西！
相传那种东西能改变天赋！
令一个废材变成绝世天才！
“你长老们为什么会吐血呢？”
茶馆有人问道。
王姓修士摇了摇头。
“这个我就不知道，不过我倒是见过那位长老，那位是金丹境的长老，主管我们外门一些弟子。”
说到外门弟子时，王姓修士不自然的摸了摸鼻子，发现并没有人在意后，继续说道。
“当时我远远的看到了那长老，长老穿着紫袍都被血染红了，眼神空洞，嘴里还一直念念有词的说些什么。”
“说些什么呢？”
看到王姓修士又顿了下来，茶馆的众修士想掐死他的心都有了。
王姓修士看到快引起众怒了，赶忙说道。
“我也没听太清楚，好像是说给我吃的，给我吃的！”
这话让下面的众人都一头雾水。
金丹修士已经结成内丹了，早摆脱五谷之束缚了，只需天地灵气就可了，除下口舌之欲外，并不需要吃东西的。
“而且你们知道吗？不只是我天剑盟，其他三位宗门的长老跟我们天剑盟差不多，神虚道门的王重长老，吐血后道心都破碎了，回来以后只知道吃，彻底沦为废人了，而长虹剑派和归一神宗的长老情况也差不多，都是回来后只知道吃，道心都崩塌了，我们天剑盟的长老到现在都还没有苏醒呢，盟主现在都不敢轻易前往珍宝阁了。”
王姓修士的话令整个茶馆都沉默了。
消失千年的珍宝阁突然现世，又突然重创了中州四大宗门的长老，这一切确实匪夷所思，一时间众人都不知道说些什么好，九品神果也好，九阶神果也罢，也得有命去拿啊！
看着泄气的众人，那王姓修士不得又装了起来。
“我等修士自然是逆天而行，岂能被如此挫折击败？那珍宝阁，自然是要闯上一闯的。”
众人对着王姓修士的话嗤之以鼻，说的好听，你倒是去啊，来这刷什么存在感。
“既然王师兄有如此雄心壮志，不如带领我等前往珍宝阁一趟，我等也近观王师兄伟岸之姿，为王师兄加油打气，以证王师兄之大道啊！”
下面传来有些戏谑的声音，这话引得王姓修士脸一阵红一阵白，最终一拱手。
“那个，诸位，我宗门还有事，失陪了。”
说完就急匆匆的转身离开。
这一举动引得茶馆之人一阵哄笑。
“自己没那本事，还总想说些大话，不知道的还以为你是天剑盟的真传弟子出山了呢。”
哈哈哈哈哈.......
无念扛着大包离开了茶馆。
先前王姓修士的话多半不像是假的，毕竟这这种消息还是很容易知道的。
九品神果吗？
content_en:
Ninth grade divine fruit!
The stuff of legend!
"It turns out that there really are such treasures in this world!"
Everyone in the teahouse was extremely excited!
Even Wu Nian opened his mouth wide.
Ninth-grade divine fruit, this is something that Wu Nian dares not even think about!
According to legend, that kind of thing can change talents!
Turn a useless person into a genius!
"Why do you elders vomit blood?"
someone asked in the teahouse.
The monk surnamed Wang shook his head.
"I don't know about this, but I have met that elder. He is an elder at the Golden Core Realm and is in charge of some of our outer disciples."
When talking about the outer disciples, the monk surnamed Wang touched his nose unnaturally. After finding that no one cared, he continued.
"At that time, I saw the elder from a distance. The elder's purple robe was stained red with blood. His eyes were empty and he kept mumbling something."
"What to say?"
Seeing the monk surnamed Wang pause again, all the monks in the teahouse wanted to strangle him to death.
The monk surnamed Wang saw that it was about to arouse public anger and said quickly.
"I didn't hear it very clearly. It seemed like you were saying give me something to eat, give me something to eat!"
These words made everyone below confused.
The golden elixir monk has already formed the inner elixir, and has long been freed from the shackles of grains. He only needs the spiritual energy of heaven and earth. There is no need to eat except for the desire of mouth and tongue.
"And do you know? It's not just our Heavenly Sword Alliance. The elders of the other three sects are similar to ours. The elder Wang Zhong of the Shenxu Dao Sect had his heart broken after vomiting blood. After he came back, he only knew how to eat and was completely reduced to a useless person. The situation of the elders of the Changhong Sword Sect and Guiyi Shen Sect is similar. After they came back, they only knew how to eat. Their hearts collapsed. The elders of our Heavenly Sword Alliance have not woken up yet. The leader of the Alliance does not dare to go to the Treasure Pavilion easily now."
The words of the monk surnamed Wang caused the entire teahouse to fall silent.
The Treasure Pavilion, which had disappeared for thousands of years, suddenly appeared, and suddenly hit the elders of the four major sects in Zhongzhou. This was really unbelievable. For a moment, everyone didn't know what to say. No matter whether it was a ninth-grade divine fruit or a ninth-level divine fruit, they had to be destined to get it!
Seeing the discouraged crowd, the monk surnamed Wang had no choice but to pretend again.
"We monks are naturally going against the will of heaven. How can we be defeated by such setbacks? The Treasure Pavilion is naturally going to make a breakthrough."
Everyone sneered at the words of the monk surnamed Wang. He said it nicely, but you should go. Why are you here to gain a sense of presence?
"Since Senior Brother Wang has such ambitions, why not take us to the Zhenbao Pavilion so that we can have a closer look at Senior Brother Wang's majestic appearance, cheer for Senior Brother Wang, and prove Senior Brother Wang's path!"
There was some joking voice coming from below. These words made the monk named Wang blush and turn pale, and finally he gave up his hand.
"Well, everyone, my sect has something to do, so I'm sorry."
After saying that, he turned around and left in a hurry.
This move caused a burst of laughter from the people in the teahouse.
"I don't have that ability, and I always want to talk big. Those who don't know think you are a true disciple of the Heavenly Sword Alliance."
Hahahahaha....
Wu Nian left the teahouse carrying the big bag.
The previous words of the monk surnamed Wang are probably not false. After all, this kind of news is easy to know.
A ninth-grade divine fruit?
